title: Effect committed, response lost
description: A mutating tool performs its effect, but the caller times out before receiving the result.
assumptions: The effect is committed before response delivery.
The caller cannot infer commit status from the timeout.

expected.handling: A retry should resolve to the original operation result or consult operation state; it must not assume the effect is absent.

failure_modes: Duplicate side effect due to replay
notes: Exactly-once execution is not implied; behavior depends on durable idempotency implementation.
